entities.summary: Co-Cathedral of Saint Mary of Vigo, known locally as A Colexiata, is a Spanish Baroque/Neoclassical Catholic temple located in Vigo. It is co-cathedral with Tui Cathedral, both sharing the seat for the Diocese of Tui-Vigo.
